description: We are doing our first hackathon ever. We mainly have experience with Python and some Physics.
summary: We've decided to design a terminal-based game where you enter the role as Project Manager for a CubeSat mission. Throughout the distinct phases of the mission you have to make decisions about the design of the CubeSat, which Launch Vehicle to use, and so on. The missions performance is assessed when it has been completed.
details:
The mission simulator lets the player asses the trade-offs scientists and project managers encounter during a science mission. Our ambition is for this to be developed into a tool that lets the general public get an insight into some of the complexities and risks associated with aerospace projects.

We have programmed the game in Python and used Git for version control and Git Hub for collaboration and project management.
